newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical PMRX sees $90 mln cash balance.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical PMRX sees $90 mln cash balance.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Marketing Services Inc said Thursday that its forecasted cash balance for the end of the fiscal year, assuming completion of the company's divestiture program, is over $90 million.

The company said it has received updated valuations from its advisers for the remaining businesses to be divested. Based on these detailed reviews, the company said it decided to adjust its original assessment of the proceeds and record the difference in its quarterly financial statements.
The company said it made the forecast on the basis of cash received to date, together with its revised estimates for proceeds from the remainder of the divestment program.
